verdict.rationale: CloudConvert is an API-first service. Official SDKs in six languages, scoped API keys, a credit-free sandbox API and documented 429/Retry-After rate-limit handling all support headless, unattended automation. However, no evidence shows a CLI, CI-specific integrations or guides, or hands-on reports of CI pipeline use. missing for 10: official CLI or documented CI/CD integration (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: For API v2, official PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET SDKs are available.
The sandbox API allows you to perform unlimited jobs and tasks without consuming your credits.
When creating an API key, you can select scopes to limit access.
If the limit is reached, a 429 error is returned, and there is a Retry-After header with the time in seconds to wait before the next request.
